claim.claim-text: 1. A sensor applicator assembly for a glucose monitoring system, comprising:
2. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 1, wherein a press button for extending the elastic plunger spring is formed on a side surface of the external container.
3. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 1, wherein the plunger body is moved from a first position to a second position due to elastic force of the elastic plunger spring,
at the first position, the plunger body and the needle withdrawing body are engaged with each other, and at the second position, the plunger body and the needle withdrawing body are disengaged.

4. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 3, wherein a fixing stepped portion is formed in the internal container, and an elastic hook engaged with the fixing stepped portion of the internal container at the first position is formed on the plunger body.
5. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 4, wherein the elastic hook is deformed due to the lateral pressure so that the engagement with the fixing stepped portion is released.
6. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 1, wherein a distance between a top end portion and a bottom end portion of the external container is maintained substantially constant.
7. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 1, wherein the top end portion of the elastic plunger spring is in contact with an inner top surface of the internal container

8. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 3, wherein the needle withdrawing elastic spring has a top end portion and a bottom end portion, and a distance between the top end portion and the bottom end portion of the needle withdrawing elastic spring is maintained substantially constant when the plunger body is moved from the first position to the second position.
9. A sensor applicator assembly for a glucose monitoring system, comprising:
10. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 9, wherein a top end portion of the elastic plunger spring is in contact with an inner top surface of the internal container.
11. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 9, wherein the plunger body is moved from a first position to a second position due to elastic force of the elastic plunger spring,
at the first position, the plunger body and the needle withdrawing body are engaged with each other, and at the second position, the plunger body and the needle withdrawing body are disengaged.

12. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 11, wherein a fixing stepped portion is formed in the internal container, and an elastic hook engaged with the fixing stepped portion of the internal container at the first position is formed on the plunger body.
13. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 12, wherein the elastic hook is deformed due to the lateral pressure so that the engagement with the fixing stepped portion is released.
14. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 9, wherein a distance between a top end portion and a bottom end portion of the external container is maintained substantially constant.

15. The sensor applicator assembly according to claim 11, wherein the needle withdrawing elastic spring has a top end portion and a bottom end portion, and a distance between the top end portion and the bottom end portion of the needle withdrawing elastic spring is maintained substantially constant when the plunger body is moved from the first position to the second position.
